context: A boss and his manager dissect a corporate-scandal column
purpose: Teach: 永久/打撃/退場/解剖/処罰/不祥事/罰則/税収

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、業界の不祥事続発に、税収への打撃まで議論してるな。
lines.en: This article covers the continuing industry scandals and even touches on the impact to tax revenue.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight pause before naming the scandals—gathering the weight of them. Steady pace. Not lecturing, but considering aloud. The tone of someone who reads policy pieces regularly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。処罰の重さ、罰則の運用、両方が問われています。
lines.en: Yes. Both the severity of punishment and how the penalties are actually enforced are being questioned.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Crisp delivery on the parallel structure. Not robotic—warmth underneath, but professional. The careful clarity of someone who's thought about these distinctions.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経営者の退場制度、永久追放まで踏み込んでる事例もあるな。
lines.en: Some cases are pushing the exec removal frameworks all the way to permanent bans.
lines.style: Noting something significant without fanfare. Slight lean forward. The cadence of someone building a case—each detail adds weight. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 失敗事例を社会で解剖していくのが、再発防止に効くようです。
lines.en: It looks like publicly analyzing failure cases—really taking them apart—is what actually stops it from happening again.
lines.style: Thoughtful but not hesitant. A genuine connection being made in real time. Warm and respectful. Slight emphasis on the cause-and-effect. The voice of someone who's seen this work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月の経営会議で議論しよう。
lines.en: Let's bring this to next month's executive meeting.
lines.style: Calm directive. Not loud, but landing with finality. The ease of someone whose decisions stick. Brief, clear, forward-moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Respectful nod in voice. Quiet, certain. Not perfunctory—genuine assent. The close of a conversation between two people who trust the exchange.
